name: Ain
source:
Daughter of [url=https://vndb.org/c136573]Zaton[/url] and younger sister of [url=https://vndb.org/c136565]Shani[/url].

My beloved girl... She is the youngest member of the House, having only recently come of age. Vain and a bit scatterbrained, she likes her little dresses, her jewels and to have fun. Under her childish veneer, I sense a depth that years to come out, and a well of insecurity about her place in the world.
